relations.note: an English king, not this week

story.body: You heard Kemp refuse a line once it was written, and you left him the right to invent the next one at Easter. Burbage used the empty house to hear a king, and asked you for an English one that is not the hunchback and not this week. You did not open that page. His exit is the cap off on the ninth line. Pope said nobody had won, and the talk had lasted longer than the two cut lines.
